propositions: Batched overlap-judge calls inherit generic 16,000-token and 600-second budgets without operation-local limits, causing three sequential structured-output retries before abstention
Malformed candidate-id responses with runaway content consumed 216–311 seconds and multiple generations before the advisory path abstained safely
RunRequest must enforce lowering-only per-request ceilings for output tokens, structured retries, transport attempts, and timeout to degrade promptly to all-candidate abstention
Overlap-judge advisory calls require explicit bounded budgets: 1,024 output tokens, one structured attempt, one transport attempt, and 60-second timeout to comply with story 9022 and ADR 0086 intent
Token-only caps and schema validation alone are insufficient to contain latency; both retry-attempt limits and timeout bounds must be enforced before model construction
